preconditions.description: Input consists of two integers n (number of vertices) and a (target angle in degrees), where n is between 3 and 10^5 inclusive, and a is between 1 and 180 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(v1), str(v2), str(v3)] and 1 <= int(v1) <= n and 1 <= int(v2) <= n and 1 <= int(v3) <= n and v1 != v2 and v2 != v3 and v1 != v3
postconditions.description: Output consists of three distinct integers v1, v2, v3 (1-based indices) representing vertices of the regular n-gon, where v2 is the vertex of the angle, and v1 and v3 lie on its sides.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(v) <= n for v in [v1, v2, v3]) and v1 != v2 and v2 != v3 and v1 != v3
postconditions.description: The output vertices are distinct and within the valid range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: abs(angle(v1, v2, v3, n) - a) == min(abs(angle(x, y, z, n) - a) for x in range(1, n+1) for y in range(1, n+1) for z in range(1, n+1) if x != y and y != z and x != z)
postconditions.description: The angle formed by vertices v1, v2, v3 is as close as possible to the target angle a, where angle(v1, v2, v3, n) is the angle in degrees at vertex v2 between sides v1-v2 and v3-v2 in a regular n-gon.
